lines.speaker: Adrian
lines.line: Dante. Mara sent me one message. Then she disappeared.

lines.speaker: Dante
lines.line: She left her car here. The ledger is in warehouse nine.

lines.speaker: Dante
lines.line: Someone with money. Take the car. Keep your head down.

lines.speaker: Dante
lines.line: I will hide the car. You find Elena. Whatever Mara found, we finish it together.

lines.speaker: Adrian
lines.line: We find Mara first. Then we make them answer.

lines.speaker: Dante
lines.line: Jonah Hale never came back for his truck. The dock supervisor has his last job order. Find out what Mara asked him to move.

lines.speaker: Supervisor
lines.line: Two loads used the same number. Jonah noticed. Check the notice on container nine, but leave my name out of this.

lines.speaker: Driver
lines.line: They put Jonah in an escort car. That car is still at the south gate. Damage its rear left tire so they cannot take the tracker away. Then get the module.

lines.speaker: Adrian
lines.line: The tracker puts Jonah at a Blackwater transfer yard. He did not run, Dante. Someone took him.

lines.speaker: Dante
lines.line: Then we stop guessing. We take this to Elena, and we do it together.
